title: Crown Duel
jesterHelp: On a tie the Jester switches. Whoever holds it starts and resolves first.
intro.sub: What does each card do where?
intro.ready: When you're ready: both press “Let's go” on your phones.
rules.weapon.t: Highest counts fully, each extra +1. Stays.
rules.allOutAtk.t: Your block becomes strength, block is 0.
rules.armour.t: Highest counts fully, each extra +1. Stays.
rules.allOutDef.t: Your strength becomes block, strength is 0.
rules.ignite.t: + value to strength, this round only. Same number as a weapon: + again.
rules.ward.t: + value to block, this round only. Same number as an armour: + again.
rules.siphon.t: 1 card from the deck face down into your corruption, +1 per matching number on your rival's weapons and armour.
rules.crit.t: If you hit: +1 damage. Same number as a weapon: +1 again.
rules.counter.t: If you get hit: draw 1 card. Same number as an armour: one more.
rules.shatter.t: Destroy your rival's lowest weapon or armour. Same number: those first.
rules.corr.t: Collect face down. Once it holds as many cards as your royal's life, you take them all into your hand – next round you can't place there and keep 2 cards.
rules.royals.t: Life and new cards per round. When a royal falls, the next one steps up. Topple the King to win.
rules.turns.t: Take turns placing 1 card face down until only 1 is left in hand (it's discarded). More cards in hand goes first. Then: Reveal → Fight → Spells → Cleanup.
rules.tips.t: Place new weapons and armour higher – a lower one discards all higher ones. Two matching symbols in spells cancel out.
rules.hit.t: Strength above the rival's block: 1 damage (plus criticals).
step.higherSw: {name} plays a lower weapon – {cards} is discarded.
step.wrongZone: {name}: {cards} in the wrong place – useless, discarded.
step.facePlant: {name}: attack AND defence – strength and block are 0!
step.cleanup: Potions, crystals and spells are discarded. Weapons and armour stay.
step.royalFalls: {name}'s royal falls! The {royal} steps up – full life, weapons and armour are gone.
step.corrupt: {name} is corrupted: {n} cards into hand, next round 2 are kept.
next.tv: On to “{phase}” – both on your phones:
next.tvEnd: Next round – both on your phones:
end.draw: Both Kings fall – it's a draw!
phone.planHint: Tap a card, then a spot.
phone.planOne: Plan exactly one card, then place it.
phone.introText: You start as {royal} with {hp} life. Topple your rival's Jack, Queen and King!
phone.corruptNote: You're corrupt: corruption locked, 2 cards stay in hand.
